text.description_html:
Acorn AIVBQ, Smooth Iron Heart Tip Offset 6 Inch Strap Hinge

The 6 Inch Smooth Iron Cabinet Heart Tip Offset Strap Hinge is suitable for lightweight doors or cabinets. It is for use on doors whose face sits 3/4 inches out from the door frame. Its old world charm is in both the heart tip design and in the smooth iron finish which is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago. The Smooth Iron Cabinet Heart Tip Strap Hinge has a lifetime no rust warranty.

Also Available: 6-1/2 Inch Smooth Iron Cabinet Heart Tip Offset Strap Hinge

Specifications for the Acorn Heart Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • For doors whose face sits 3/4" out from the door frame.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the 6" Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 6"
  • Offset: 3/4"

Sold as a pair (2-hinges).
